title: Copper skies
description: create aeronautics and more, trains, tracks and moreeeee
body:
This modpack is centered around the Create: Aeronautics experience, focusing on building advanced flying machines, airships, and mechanical contraptions. It expands the core gameplay with additional Create addons and supporting mods that enhance engineering, automation, exploration, and overall creativity.

Players can design complex airborne vehicles, build massive moving structures, and experiment with physics-based engineering systems. The modpack also includes quality-of-life improvements and performance-focused mods to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys technical builds, sandbox creativity, and the freedom to bring mechanical ideas to life in Minecraft.
